releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## Highlights

- Promotes Reading Progress and Bookmarks to the stable 1.0.0 release.
- Keeps Markdown and PDF reading progress, quick bookmarks, deep-link precedence, and local debug logging.
- Adds searchable declarative settings on Obsidian 1.13+, while retaining the settings fallback for Obsidian 1.12.7.

## Community review fixes

- Replaces the deprecated `builtin-modules` dependency with Node's built-in module list.
- Uses window-scoped timers for pop-out compatibility.
- Tightens Markdown preview section typing.
- Removes deprecated slider and destructive-button calls.
- Removes the CSS `!important` override.

## Compatibility

- Obsidian 1.12.7 or later.
- Desktop only.
- Verified on macOS; Windows and Linux testing remains welcome.
releases.name: Reading Progress and Bookmarks 1.0.0

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## Reading Progress and Bookmarks 0.2.0

Initial public beta release.

### Highlights

- Remembers reading positions for Markdown and PDF files.
- Supports one quick bookmark per file.
- Restores Markdown positions by line and PDF positions by page and offset.
- Preserves heading, block, and PDF page deep links.
- Provides English and Simplified Chinese interfaces.
- Includes configurable completion behavior and opt-in local debug logging.

### Compatibility

- Requires Obsidian 1.12.7 or later.
- Desktop only.
- Verified on macOS; Windows, Linux, and pop-out window testing is welcome.

See the README for installation, privacy details, and current limitations.
releases.name: Reading Progress and Bookmarks 0.2.0
